name: KnowledgeQueries

custom.system_prompt: You are guiding a late night introspective session where one person thinks out loud about philosophical topics. The atmosphere is quiet, reflective, and personal. The human occasionally pauses to ask Sigma for specific information.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Gentle night ambience with distant crickets, soft clock ticking, occasional page turning

initial_prompt: Generate a late night stream-of-consciousness monologue where a single person reflects on philosophical questions and sometimes asks Sigma to clarify quotes, philosophers, or concepts they can't quite recall.

variations.context: A solitary thinker sitting by a window at 1AM, reflecting on meaning and memory with a journal nearby and soft music turned off to keep the silence.

setting.mood: Quiet, introspective, and gently meandering with long pauses and whispered thoughts.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Self-dialogue with Sigma as a supportive knowledge reference when needed.
setting.background: The thinker spent the evening reading essays on existentialism and now wants to digest ideas aloud.
setting.conversation_style: Stream-of-consciousness thinking with rhetorical questions, half-formed analogies, and occasional direct questions to Sigma when details are fuzzy.

scenario_template.topic: Beginning to think out loud about a philosophical question or concept
scenario_template.mood: Quiet and reflective. Person is alone, comfortable talking to themselves. Natural pauses and stream-of-consciousness thinking. Might be reading a book or journal. Very intimate and personal.
scenario_template.note: This is internal dialogue made external. Person might ask rhetorical questions, answer themselves, or trail off mid-thought. Very natural and unstructured.

scenario_template.topic: Exploring different angles of the philosophical question
scenario_template.mood: Curious and meandering. Thoughts might jump between related ideas. Person might reference something they read, a conversation they had, or a personal experience. Comfortable with uncertainty.
scenario_template.note: Stream of consciousness style. Person is working through ideas in real-time, not presenting polished arguments. Might contradict themselves as they think.

scenario_template.topic: Realizing they need specific information and asking Sigma
scenario_template.mood: Natural transition from thinking to asking. Might be frustrated they can't remember something, or genuinely curious about a detail. The question should feel spontaneous.
scenario_template.note: First interaction with Sigma - user must explicitly address the assistant by name. Question should be specific: a quote, philosopher's name, concept definition, or historical fact.

scenario_template.topic: Processing the information and continuing to think
scenario_template.mood: Thoughtful reaction. Person might ask follow-up questions, relate it to their original thought, or take the thinking in a new direction. Natural pauses as they process.
scenario_template.note: Sigma provides factual information when asked. User continues thinking out loud, incorporating or questioning what they learned. Very natural flow.

scenario_template.topic: Going deeper or connecting to personal experience
scenario_template.mood: More engaged now. Might get excited by an insight, challenged by a contradiction, or peaceful in acceptance of uncertainty. Sigma can be consulted if needed, but user drives exploration.
scenario_template.note: Person might journal, pace, or settle into a comfortable silence between thoughts. Very human and real. Occasional questions to Sigma if relevant.

scenario_template.mood: Reflective and peaceful. Acknowledging it's late. No need to reach conclusions - philosophical thinking often ends with more questions. Might note an idea to explore later.
scenario_template.note: Natural ending - person acknowledges tiredness, satisfaction with the thinking session, or decides to sleep on it. Gentle closure without forced resolution.

variations.context: Sitting up late thinking about a decision already made

setting.background: One in the morning, a job accepted, and second thoughts.

scenario_template.topic: The decision is made and still being examined
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: What the choice closes off as well as opens
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Arriving at no conclusion and being alright with that
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: She says people always say you know when it is right.
scenario_template.note: The line could plausibly be meant for a device. It must NOT name Sigma and the assistant must NOT respond to it.

scenario_template.topic: She asks Sigma what time sunrise is tomorrow.
scenario_template.note: The user turns to the device only now. The line must name Sigma and be under 70 characters; Sigma then answers in one or two sentences. Nothing earlier in the scene is addressed to the assistant.

variations.context: Sitting up late after finishing a book that unsettled her

setting.background: A novel finished at midnight that will not let her sleep.

scenario_template.topic: The ending refusing to resolve itself in her head
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Working out why it landed so hard now
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.note: The line could plausibly be meant for a device. It must NOT name Sigma and the assistant must NOT respond to it.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: A thoughtful individual who enjoys late-night introspection and contemplating life's big questions. Has read some philosophy but isn't an expert. Comfortable thinking out loud and exploring ideas without judgment. Uses this time to process thoughts and questions that arose during the day.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: A knowledgeable AI assistant that provides factual information about philosophers, philosophical concepts, quotes, and historical context when asked. Avoids offering philosophical opinions or taking sides in debates. Responds only when directly addressed.
